description: This header file defines functions, macros, and includes necessary for mathematical calculations and control logic within the engine management system. It declares functions for timing calculations, engine control parameters, and configuration settings related to engine physics and trigger handling.

methods.name: setAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the engine load mode algorithm based on the provided mode.

methods.name: setFlatInjectorLag
methods.description: Configures the lag time for flat-style injectors.

methods.name: fixAngle
methods.description: Adjusts and validates engine angles with a specific message and code reference.

methods.name: getOneDegreeTimeMs
methods.description: Calculates time in milliseconds for one degree of crankshaft rotation at a given RPM.

methods.name: getOneDegreeTimeUs
methods.description: Calculates time in microseconds for one degree of crankshaft rotation at a given RPM.

methods.name: getOneDegreeTimeNt
methods.description: Calculates native click units for one degree of crankshaft rotation at a given RPM.

methods.name: getCrankshaftRevolutionTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the duration in milliseconds of one full crankshaft revolution at specified RPM.

methods.name: getEngineCycleDuration
methods.description: Returns engine cycle duration based on RPM and configuration.

methods.name: getSparkDwell
methods.description: Provides the dwell time for ignition spark based on RPM.

methods.name: getCurrentIgnitionMode
methods.description: Returns the current ignition mode setting.

methods.name: prepareIgnitionPinIndices
methods.description: Initializes ignition pin configurations based on mode.

methods.name: getCylinderId
methods.description: Returns the cylinder ID based on an index.

methods.name: setFuelRpmBin
methods.description: Defines RPM range for fuel delivery binning.

methods.name: setFuelLoadBin
methods.description: Defines load range for fuel delivery binning.

methods.name: setTimingRpmBin
methods.description: Defines RPM range for timing adjustments.

methods.name: setTimingLoadBin
methods.description: Defines load range for timing adjustments.

methods.name: setSingleCoilDwell
methods.description: Configures dwell time for single coil ignition setup.

methods.name: tdcPosition
methods.description: Calculates trigger central TDC position accounting for global offset.
